links.outcome: Diagnostic and next-step accuracy of DeepSeek-R1 compared head-to-head with OpenAI o1 on same cases
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 diagnostic accuracy 70.4% vs 63.0% for o1 (7.3% difference, P=.02); next-step 82.7% vs 75.8% (6.9% difference, P=.01); intermodel agreement moderate (κ=0.422).
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1 achieved a higher diagnostic accuracy of 70.4% (297 of 422 cases) compared with 63.0% (266 of 422 cases) for OpenAI o1, a 7.3% difference (95% CI, 1.0%-13.7%; P = .02).

unlisted_practices: Comparing open-weight reasoning LLM cost per query against proprietary LLM
Plan-and-Solve Plus prompt engineering for clinical questions

screen.reason: The study is an automated benchmark evaluation comparing two LLMs (DeepSeek-R1 vs OpenAI o1) on ophthalmology clinical challenge questions without evaluating a human-in-the-loop or deployment safeguard practice.
